title.zh: Crypto Exchange CoinEx Is Shutting Down After Nine Years, Giving Users Until December to Cash Out
title.en: Crypto Exchange CoinEx Is Shutting Down After Nine Years, Giving Users Until December to Cash Out

current_state.zh: CoinEx will shut down on Dec. 22, 2026 after nine years of operation, halting new signups and spot trading while offering an uncapped buyback of its CET token at the original 0.005 USDT listing price.
current_state.en: CoinEx will shut down on Dec. 22, 2026 after nine years of operation, halting new signups and spot trading while offering an uncapped buyback of its CET token at the original 0.005 USDT listing price.
